title: Reconstructive surgical peri-implantitis treatment: bovine bone graft with vs without hyaluronic acid
product: cerabone plus (test) vs cerabone (control), sites covered with mucoderm
supports: THE strongest +HyA entry and the only RCT on the product: greater implant stability at 3 and 6 months (p=0.009 and 0.032), greater vertical marginal bone gain (p<0.05), higher gain of keratinised mucosa width and mucosal thickness, complete BOP reduction in the test group. Licenses hyaluronate benefit claims IN RECONSTRUCTIVE PERI-IMPLANTITIS TREATMENT specifically — not in grafting generally. Cited in botiss training decks (Sept 2026 upload).
